title: Ramadan and the Two Eids — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: During Ramadan, Muslims fast from dawn to sunset, and the month ends with the festival of Eid al-Fitr. Eid al-Adha, the festival of sacrifice, coincides with the Hajj pilgrimage season. This overview edition presents Ramadan and the Two Eids within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.
